- Overestimate prices after sentiment spikes (especially >0.5) — model tends to overshoot and fail to correct quickly.
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is low or negative (sentiment <0.27) — model shows reluctance to drop sharply.
- Lag in downward corrections: model often holds high prices longer than true market reacts — especially after sharp drops.
- Mean reversion bias: model overweights recent highs and fails to adjust for long-term trend reversal.
- Horizon-specific error: 30-day forecasts overreact to short-term sentiment shifts — model is too sensitive to 1-2 week sentiment swings.
- Avoid “peak-predict” behavior: if sentiment rises sharply, model should not immediately peak — instead, allow for a lagged correction or gradual decline.
